name: dependabot
title: Dependabot config
description: A Dependabot config that raises a weekly pull request when Flam design packages such as @flam-ai/tokens publish a new version.

files.content:
# Raises a weekly pull request when Flam design packages publish a new version.
version: 2
updates:
  - package-ecosystem: npm
    directory: /
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
    groups:
      flam-design:
        patterns:
          - "@flam-ai/*"
